import subprocess, time, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ADB = r"C:\Users\hzq00\Downloads\platform-tools-latest-windows\platform-tools\adb.exe"
SERIAL = "AVNS023705001888"
OUT = Path(r"C:\Users\hzq00\Documents\Codex\2026-08-29\hy4-ai-ai-ai-ai-01a02ee0\work\sidebar_fix\live_verify")
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def run(args, timeout=40):
    cmd = [ADB, "-L", "tcp:5038", "-s", SERIAL] + args
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=timeout)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def save(name, text):
    (OUT / name).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

stamp = datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
journal = [f"stamp={stamp}"]

# connectivity
rc, so, se = run(["get-state"])
journal.append(f"get-state rc={rc} stdout={so!r} stderr={se!r}")
save("get_state.txt", f"rc={rc}\nstdout={so}\nstderr={se}\n")

rc, so, se = run(["devices", "-l"])
save("devices.txt", so + ("\nSTDERR\n" + se if se else ""))

# never use default adb
keys = [
    ("uptime.txt", ["shell", "uptime"]),
    ("boot_completed.txt", ["shell", "getprop", "sys.boot_completed"]),
    ("build.txt", ["shell", "getprop", "ro.build.display.id"]),
    ("fingerprint.txt", ["shell", "getprop", "ro.build.fingerprint"]),
    ("screen_dumpsys.txt", ["shell", "dumpsys", "power"]),
    ("wm_size.txt", ["shell", "wm", "size"]),
    ("is_ota_finished.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "is_ota_finished"]),
    ("dockBar.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "honor.globalWindow.dockBar"]),
    ("float_task_state.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "float_task_state"]),
    ("dockbar_tooltip_enabled.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "global", "dockbar_tooltip_enabled"]),
    ("navigation_mode.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "navigation_mode"]),
    ("multi_win_gesture_status.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "multi_win_gesture_status"]),
    ("dock_max_num_statue.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "dock_max_num_statue"]),
    ("ai_navigationbar.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "system", "ai_navigationbar"]),
    ("settings_ai_recommend.txt", ["shell", "settings", "get", "secure", "settings_ai_recommend"]),
]
for name, args in keys:
    rc, so, se = run(args)
    save(name, f"rc={rc}\nstdout={so}\nstderr={se}\n")
    journal.append(f"{name}: rc={rc} out={so.strip()!r} err={se.strip()!r}")

# package enabled
for pkg in [
    "com.hihonor.android.FloatTasks",
    "com.hihonor.hndockbar",
    "com.android.systemui",
    "com.hihonor.android.launcher",
    "com.hihonor.aidock",
]:
    rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "package", pkg])
    save(f"pkg_{pkg}.txt", so if so else se)
    # extract enabled
    enabled = []
    for line in (so or "").splitlines():
        if "enabled=" in line.lower() or "User 0:" in line or "enabledSetting" in line or "enabled=" in line:
            if "enabled" in line.lower() or "User 0" in line:
                enabled.append(line.strip())
    save(f"enabled_{pkg}.txt", "\n".join(enabled[:40]))

# pm path / list
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "pm", "path", "com.hihonor.hndockbar"])
save("pm_path_hndockbar.txt", so + se)
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "pm", "list", "packages", "-d"])
save("pm_disabled.txt", so)

# processes
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "ps", "-A"])
save("ps_all.txt", so)
hits = "\n".join([ln for ln in so.splitlines() if any(x in ln.lower() for x in ["hndock", "floattask", "systemui", "launcher", "yoyo", "aidock", "gkd"])])
save("ps_hits.txt", hits)

# windows
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "window", "windows"], timeout=60)
save("windows_full.txt", so)
win_hits = []
for key in ["GestureNavDock", "GestureNavLeft", "GestureNavRight", "Dock", "Float", "hndock", "HnDock", "AI", "sidebar", "FloatBall", "FloatTask"]:
    for ln in so.splitlines():
        if key.lower() in ln.lower():
            win_hits.append(ln)
save("windows_hits.txt", "\n".join(win_hits[:400]))

# visible named windows
named = []
cur = None
buf = []
for ln in so.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith("  Window #") and "Window{" in ln:
        if cur:
            named.append((cur, "\n".join(buf)))
        cur = ln.strip()
        buf = [ln]
    elif cur:
        buf.append(ln)
if cur:
    named.append((cur, "\n".join(buf)))
dock_blocks = []
for title, block in named:
    if any(x in title for x in ["GestureNavDock", "GestureNavLeft", "GestureNavRight", "Float", "Dock", "hndock"]):
        dock_blocks.append(block[:2500])
save("windows_named_blocks.txt", "\n\n====\n\n".join(dock_blocks[:20]))

# services
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "activity", "services", "DockMain"], timeout=40)
save("svc_dockmain.txt", so[:200000])
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "activity", "services", "hndockbar"], timeout=40)
save("svc_hndockbar.txt", so[:200000])
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "activity", "services", "Float"], timeout=40)
save("svc_float.txt", so[:150000])

# keepalive
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "deviceidle", "whitelist"])
save("deviceidle_whitelist.txt", so)
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "cmd", "appops", "get", "com.netease.cloudmusic"])
save("appops_netease.txt", so)
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "cmd", "appops", "get", "tv.danmaku.bili"])
save("appops_bili_tv.txt", so)
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "cmd", "appops", "get", "com.bilibili.app.in"])
save("appops_bili_in.txt", so)

# settings owner
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "settings"], timeout=60)
save("dumpsys_settings.txt", so[:400000])
ota_lines = "\n".join([ln for ln in so.splitlines() if "is_ota_finished" in ln or "dockBar" in ln or "dockbar" in ln.lower() or "float_task" in ln])
save("dumpsys_settings_hits.txt", ota_lines)

# current focus / top
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "window", "displays"])
save("window_displays.txt", so[:200000] if so else se)
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "dumpsys", "activity", "activities"], timeout=40)
save("activity_top.txt", so[:250000])

# screenshot
rc, so, se = run(["shell", "screencap", "-p", "/sdcard/ai_sidebar_live.png"])
journal.append(f"screencap rc={rc} err={se.strip()!r}")
pull = subprocess.run([ADB, "-L", "tcp:5038", "-s", SERIAL, "pull", "/sdcard/ai_sidebar_live.png", str(OUT / "ai_sidebar_live.png")], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", timeout=30)
journal.append(f"pull rc={pull.returncode} out={pull.stdout!r} err={pull.stderr!r}")

# recent logcat (short)
rc, so, se = run(["logcat", "-d", "-t", "400", "-s", "hn_GestureNavManager:D", "NavDockBarController:D", "HnDockBar:D", "DockBar:D", "hndockbar:D"], timeout=40)
save("logcat_tags.txt", so if so else se)
rc, so, se = run(["logcat", "-d", "-t", "800"], timeout=40)
hits = "\n".join([ln for ln in (so or "").splitlines() if any(k.lower() in ln.lower() for k in ["isOtaFinished","mDockDisableFlag","GestureNavDock","DockMain","hndockbar","isShowDock","mIsShowDockEnable","createDockController","updateOtaFinished","dockBar","FloatTasks"])])
save("logcat_hits.txt", hits)

save("journal.txt", "\n".join(journal) + "\n")
print("DONE")
print("\n".join(journal))

        print("  = 1 -> NOOP")
        led("settings_dockBar", DOCKBAR_KEY, "NOOP", "already 1")
    else:
        if dry:
            print("  = %s -> [dry] 将设为 1" % cur)
        else:
            sh("shell", "settings", "put", "secure", DOCKBAR_KEY, "1")
            after = get("secure", DOCKBAR_KEY)
            writes += 1
            print("  %s -> %s" % (cur, after))
            led("settings_dockBar", DOCKBAR_KEY, "OK" if after == "1" else "FAIL", "before=%s" % cur)
            log({"event": "settings_put", "ns": "secure", "key": DOCKBAR_KEY, "before": cur, "after": after})

    # ---------- P6 重启桌面，让侧边栏热区按新值重建 ----------
    print("--- P6 重启 launcher（热区重建，非 reboot）---")
    if dry:
        print("  [dry] 将 force-stop com.hihonor.android.launcher")
    else:
        pid_before = [l for l in sh("shell", "ps -A -o PID,NAME")[0].splitlines() if "com.hihonor.android.launcher" in l]
        sh("shell", "am", "force-stop", "com.hihonor.android.launcher")
        time.sleep(6)
        pid_after = [l for l in sh("shell", "ps -A -o PID,NAME")[0].splitlines() if "com.hihonor.android.launcher" in l]
        writes += 1
        print("  重启前: %s" % (pid_before or "(none)"))
        print("  重启后: %s" % (pid_after or "(none)"))
        led("force_stop", "com.hihonor.android.launcher", "OK" if pid_after else "FAIL",
            "before=%s after=%s" % (pid_before, pid_after))
        log({"event": "force_stop_launcher", "before": pid_before, "after": pid_after})

    # ---------- P7 复核 ----------
    print()
    print("--- P7 复核 ---")
    for p in KEEP_ALIVE:
        print("  %-28s doze白名单=%-5s standby=%-3s RUN_ANY=%-6s RUN_IN=%-6s NOTIF=%s" % (
            p, in_whitelist(p), sh("shell", "am", "get-standby-bucket", p)[0],
            appops_get(p, "RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND"), appops_get(p, "RUN_IN_BACKGROUND"),
            appops_get(p, "POST_NOTIFICATION")))
    print("  secure %s = %s" % (DOCKBAR_KEY, get("secure", DOCKBAR_KEY)))
    print("  实际写入次数: %d" % writes)

    log({"event": "stage5_done", "writes": writes, "dry": dry})
    journal.close()
    ledger.close()
    print()
    print("journal:", journal_path)
    print("ledger :", ledger_path)
    return 0
